name: CaptchaFox
description: Adds CaptchaFox (a privacy-focused hosted CAPTCHA provider) as a challenge type for the CAPTCHA module. Renders the CaptchaFox widget from cdn.captchafox.com and verifies the response SERVER-SIDE: Drupal POSTs the response token + secret key to https://api.captchafox.com/siteverify and only lets the form pass on success:true, so the client cannot self-assert.
project_description: The CaptchaFox module integrates the CaptchaFox web service into Drupal's CAPTCHA system. CaptchaFox is a privacy-friendly, GDPR-compliant hosted CAPTCHA that protects forms from bots, spam and fraud. After enabling both CaptchaFox and CAPTCHA, a CaptchaFox tab appears under the CAPTCHA settings (admin/config/people/captcha/captchafox) where you enter the site key and secret key obtained from portal.captchafox.com. You then select which forms show the CaptchaFox challenge on the CAPTCHA administration page. The widget is served from cdn.captchafox.com and the submitted response is verified server-side against api.captchafox.com/siteverify.
